source: Foundation 12 Daily Practice · Week 1 (student booklet + teacher answer key)
title: Saturday Daily Practice · Review Session 2
subtitle: Words about me + four new sounds (EPIU 3.1, 3.3, 4.1, 4.2)
intro: Review Session 2. Work alone for about 60 minutes. Send one photo of exercises 3B–3F and one voice note (3H).
send_today: Send: 1 photo of 3B–3F + 1 voice note (3H), by 23:00 today.

steps.title: 3A · Say the 15 words
lines: university · faculty · major · freshman · lecturer · classmate · hometown · province · nationality · surname · first name · hobby · ambition · introduce · describe
steps.note: Read each word aloud 3 times. Bold = the stressed syllable.

steps.title: 3B · Which word is it?
steps.instructions: Write the word that matches each definition.

items.label: 1. The place where you study after high school. ______
2. A part of a university, for example Medicine or English. ______
3. Vietnamese, British or Korean: it is your … ______
4. A student in the same class as you. ______
5. To tell people someone's name when they meet for the first time. ______

steps.title: 3C · Complete the sentences
steps.instructions: Use each word once: hometown · surname · hobby · ambition · lecturer · province · describe · freshman

items.label: 1. My ______ is Lê, and my first name is Hoa.
2. Our ______ teaches us English on Wednesdays.
3. My ______ is Sầm Sơn. It's near the sea.
4. I'm a ______. This is my first year at university.
5. Nghệ An is a big ______ in the centre of Việt Nam.
6. My ______ is to become a nurse.

steps.title: 3D · Where is the stress?
steps.instructions: Say each word and clap. Write it in the right column: classmate · lecturer · ambition · university · surname · introduce · nationality · major. Stress on the 1st syllable: classmate, lecturer, surname, major. Stress on another syllable: ambition, university, introduce, nationality.

open.q: Write each word in the right column (1st syllable / another syllable).

steps.title: 3E · Four new sounds: sort the words
steps.instructions: /uː/ = round lips, long (food) · /ʊ/ = lips a little round, short (book) · /ɑː/ = open wide, long (car) · /ʌ/ = half open, quick (cup). Write each word in the right column: moon · put · start · son · June · full · class · love · room · cook · glass · come

steps.title: 3F · Odd one out
steps.instructions: Type the word with a different vowel sound.

steps.title: EPIU 3.1 · Circle the words with /uː/
steps.instructions: Play Audio A18, then circle the nine /uː/ words: food · four · June · look · news · room · school · soup · spoon · sugar · town · Tuesday · two. Listen and repeat.

steps.title: EPIU 3.3 · Circle the words with /ʊ/
steps.instructions: Play Audio A20, then circle the six /ʊ/ words: book · cookery · cough · could · good · looking · lunch · soon · sugar · thought · through. Listen and repeat.

steps.title: EPIU 4.1 · Words with /ɑː/
steps.instructions: Play Audio A26, then write the words in the correct column: garden · March · part · talk · warm · watch. Play A26 again and repeat every word.

open.q: /ɑː/: artist, garden, March, part · other: square, talk, warm, watch (check your answers after class).

steps.title: EPIU 4.2 · Words with /ʌ/
steps.instructions: Play Audio A27, then write the words in the correct column: fun · home · lots · money · mother · push. Play A27 again and repeat every word.

open.q: /ʌ/: country, fun, money, mother · other: business, home, lots, push

steps.title: 3H · Voice note
lines: My classmate is a freshman from Thanh Hóa province.
Our lecturer is in the Faculty of English.
Look at the blue moon in June.
My mother and my brother love the park.
steps.note: Read the 15 words in 3A once, then read these 4 sentences 3 times and record them.

steps.title: ★ Challenge A · What's the question?
steps.instructions: Optional. Write the question for each answer.

steps.title: ★ Challenge B · Answer about you
steps.instructions: Optional. Answer the 5 questions about you. Say each answer aloud 2 times.

open.q: Answer: 1. What's your surname? 2. What's your nationality? 3. What's your major? 4. Where's your hometown? 5. What's your ambition?
